column1: # microG and Aurora Store prebuilts for the Q25 (SABLE_Q25_MICROG=YES, Q4 and later).
# No APK is tracked in git. scripts/fetch-microg.sh downloads each row's url into
# SABLE_MICROG_CACHE (default $SABLE_BUILD_ROOT/microg-cache) and refuses any file whose
# sha256 differs; scripts/stage-product.sh checks the hashes again before it stages them.
# The APKs are installed exactly as their developers signed them (presigned): LineageOS
# lets only the microG release key spoof Google's signature, so they must not be re-signed.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   module        Soong module name (product/q25/microg/Android.bp)
#   package       application id
#   version       versionName (versionCode)
#   sha256        sha256 of the APK
#   url           official download
# Sources and how the hashes were taken (2026-10-22):
#   GmsCore, FakeStore: microG release v0.3.17.252432 (tag commit 32bc8954ff872d0e1a05ddfae81561b6dbecef69),
#     https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/releases/tag/v0.3.17.252432. sha256 as published in the
#     release's asset digests (each APK also has a .asc PGP signature by the microG team).
#     "FakeStore" is the microG Companion (com.android.vending), built from the same repo.
#     The standalone GsfProxy is not shipped: it is only for pre-2016 C2DM apps and GmsCore
#     handles Google Services Framework itself.
#   AuroraStore: Aurora Store 4.8.4 (76), https://gitlab.com/AuroraOSS/AuroraStore/-/releases/4.8.4.
#     The standard build, not "preload": preload asks for INSTALL_PACKAGES and DELETE_PACKAGES
#     as a privileged app; the standard build installs through the normal confirmation.
#     sha256 computed from the file downloaded on 2026-10-22.
# To update: change version, url and sha256 in one reviewed commit, then
#   NETWORK_FETCH_AUTHORIZED=YES bash scripts/fetch-microg.sh
module
GmsCore
FakeStore
AuroraStore
